K2S.title: This World Chess Championship was stopped after 48 games #shorts
K2S.desc:
Moscow, 1984-85: Karpov against Kasparov, first to six wins. Karpov led 5-0, Kasparov came back to 5-3, and after five months and 48 games (40 draws) the FIDE president stopped the match without a winner. In 2018 the World Championship had twelve classical games and all twelve were draws, and between 2016 and 2021 the title matches went 19 classical games in a row without a winner.

Should a draw count less than a win?
